[assistant] - [High] .claude/settings.local.json:40 — Allowlisting `codex exec -s danger-full-access ... *` permits arbitrary full-access command execution and weakens the shell permission boundary.
- [Medium] core/hooks/skill_self_evolution.py:164 — `_current_run_id` is never set by the hook or event bus, so skill evolution events are always stored under `_skill_evolution` and cannot be correlated or replayed with the actual run.
- [Low] core/events/run_event.py:113 — `os.path.getsize()` runs after every append until 1 MiB, adding avoidable filesystem overhead on a hot event logging path.
